promotion.basis: Gap-Filler D4 promotion ruling (Nov 21, 2026): Isaac adopted the NHL player-props taxonomy proposal in full; that adoption is his promotion ruling for the NHL source (the NHL official web API, api-web.nhle.com), promoting it from answers-only collected data to a line-making input. This store was materialized from the collected layer under that ruling; it is not direct provider-harvest data and must not be represented as such.
